description: Partially update an arm profile in the external alarm manager. Omitted fields remain unchanged; nullable fields clear their existing value when set to null. Only available when using external alarm manager.

requestBody.name: title
requestBody.description: Omit to retain the existing title. A title cannot be cleared.

requestBody.name: activation_delay
requestBody.description: Delay in seconds. Omit to retain the existing delay; use null to clear it.

requestBody.name: deactivation_delay
requestBody.description: Delay in seconds. Omit to retain the existing delay; use null to clear it.

requestBody.name: schedule
requestBody.description: Omit to retain the existing schedule; use null to clear it.

children.name: end
children.description: Use 24:00 or 23:59 for end of day. UOS returns end of day as 23:59.

requestBody.name: alarm_ids
requestBody.description: Omit to retain the existing associations; use null or an empty array to clear them.

requestBody.name: pin_code
requestBody.description: Omit to retain the existing PIN; use null to clear it.

fields.name: state
fields.description: External Alarm Manager profile arm state. Use this when `nvr.featureFlags.useExternalAlarmManager` is true. When it is false, see `nvr.armMode` for Local Alarm Manager profile arm state.

  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:

    body:

      activation_delay: 0
